weeksDescription: Open the current week or choose All weeks. Expand a week to see its instructions, lectures, files and assignment grades.
semesterSubjects: Expand or collapse current semester subjects
noSemesterSubjects: No subjects enrolled for this semester yet.
instructionsRequired: Add text instructions or at least one instruction file.
enableSubmissions: Allow students to upload completed work
submissionsDisabled: The instructor has not enabled submissions for this assignment.
uploadHint: Up to 5 files, 5 MB each. PDF, Office documents, JPG, PNG or ZIP.
fileType: Choose a PDF, Office document, JPG, PNG or ZIP file.
fileSize: Files must be non-empty and no larger than 5 MB each.
outOfRange: The number is outside the allowed range.
title: Title
author: Author
selectCourseToCreate: Select a course to create an assignment.
invalidGrades: Check that each score is between zero and its component maximum.
enterScores: Enter at least one score before saving.
saveBeforePublish: Save your changes before publishing or locking grades.
gradesLocked: Grades are locked. Contact the administrator to unlock them.
confirmGradeStatus: This changes grade visibility or editing access for the entire class. Continue?
weightsTotal: Component weights must add up to 100%.
invalidAttendance: Use today's date or an earlier date and select enrolled students only.
componentsPublished: Grade components can only be changed while grades are in draft.
completeGrades: Enter all students' component scores and ensure weights total 100% before publishing.
invalidFiles: Choose valid files for this course.
alreadyGraded: This submission has been graded and cannot be changed.
attendanceWarning: Attendance is below the university warning threshold of {{threshold}}%. Sessions without a record are included in the percentage.
weekRequiresCourse: A weekly announcement must belong to a course.
assignmentGradesHint: All assignments for this course, with your submission status, score and feedback.
resultsBreakdownHint: Course totals follow the configured assessment weights. Expand assignment grades to see every assignment score and feedback.
combinedGradesHint: Grade components and all course assignments, with scores, status and feedback.
